title: Tank math
note: Computed from the game files: 100% crew, no equipment or skills unless selected. Formulas: exponential aiming convergence, linear penetration drop from 100 to 500 m, spotting as “view range − (view range − 50) × camouflage”.

handling.title: Gun handling
handling.description: How the aiming circle blooms from moving, hull and turret traverse and firing — and how many seconds it takes to aim back in.
handling.scoreHint: Circle at 100 m, 2 s after stopping from top speed with the turret traversing. Lower is better.
handling.chart: Dispersion at 100 m over time after an action

ballistics.title: Ballistics
ballistics.description: AP and APCR penetration drops linearly from 100 to 500 m; HEAT and HE keep their penetration. Flight time follows the shell velocity and gravity.
ballistics.tableCaption: Shells compared with the first one

spotting.title: Spotting
spotting.description: My view range against the target's camouflage and back: who spots whom first. Within 50 m a tank is always visible, beyond 445 m never.

isMoving.label: Moving
isMoving.hint: Moving camouflage is lower and binoculars are off

isFiring.label: Firing
isFiring.hint: The tank's camouflage is multiplied by the gun factor

isFoliageNear.label: Bush within 15 m
isFoliageNear.hint: When firing, a near bush keeps only 30% of its bonus

hasPaint.label: Camouflage paint
hasPaint.hint: Paint bonus from the tank files

verdict.even: We spot each other at once

spotting.iSpotHint: My view range against the target's camouflage
spotting.theySpotHint: The target's view range against my camouflage
spotting.limits: Spotting is capped at 445 m, but view range above 445 m still helps against camouflage. Within 50 m a tank is always visible.

tool.title: Tank math
tool.description: Gun handling, shell ballistics and a spotting calculator for any tank.
tool.emptyDescription: We will work out aiming, penetration by distance and spotting against any opponent.
